title: bug: JetBrains Epic detail sends its typed edits and an Archived status in one UPDATE_EPIC frame and closes before the reply. Since 09529122 (task-625c7cfe) the daemon refuses that whole save for an epic with a PLANNING, AWAITING_APPROVAL or WORKING row, so every typed edit is lost behind a raw "[NOT_ALLOWED] … via moe.set_task_status" balloon. On a quiet epic, the same combo pick archives every task with no confirmation
description:
Filed by hunt #14 (task-d5d58972, 2026-11-03, architect-1dd28c7c). This is the IDE follow-through on task-625c7cfe, and it was hunt #9's held item (b). JetBrains is first; the VS Code twin is held back until this row lands.

PROBLEM (HEAD 942717bc)
- The dialog and the frame:
  - moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/EpicDetailDialog.kt:31 offers ARCHIVED in the status combo unconditionally.
  - Save (:76-89) sends title, description, architectureNotes, epicRails and the chosen status in ONE frame through MoeCommandSender.updateEpicDetails (services/MoeCommandSender.kt:104-118).
  - It then calls close(OK_EXIT_CODE) (:88) before any reply.
- What the daemon does with it since 09529122:
  - /ws UPDATE_EPIC (packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.ts:677) calls applyEpicUpdate (tools/updateEpic.ts:37-52).
  - A move to ARCHIVED runs archive_epic FIRST (:50). The companion fields are written only after it succeeds (:51).
  - archive_epic refuses while any task of the epic is PLANNING, AWAITING_APPROVAL or WORKING (tools/archiveEpic.ts:12 IN_FLIGHT, refusal at :61-67). That is all-or-nothing by design: the typed title, description, notes and rails are never written.
- What the human sees: MoeToolWindowPanel.kt:349-354 shows the raw ERROR text: "UPDATE_EPIC: [NOT_ALLOWED] archive epic not allowed: Epic "epic-…" has N in-flight task(s) (task-…:WORKING). Move them to BACKLOG first via moe.set_task_status (release_task keeps …)". It gives an epic id and task ids, not titles, and MCP instructions addressed to an agent. The dialog is already closed and the edits are gone.
- The success path:
  - archive_epic archives EVERY not-yet-archived task: BACKLOG, REVIEW (un-reviewed work included), DONE and BLOCKED (archiveEpic.ts, the loop after the in-flight gate).
  - One combo pick does that with no confirmation. The Delete button beside it confirms (EpicDetailDialog.kt:91-103).
  - Setting the epic back to ACTIVE later is a plain update that leaves its tasks ARCHIVED, and the board does not render ARCHIVED rows.
- Not affected: the epic-header drag never sends ARCHIVED (MoeToolWindowPanel.kt mapEpicStatus).

EVIDENCE
- Daemon side, the exact frame the dialog builds, against a real StateManager + MoeWebSocketServer on an ephemeral port. The repro is /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-d5d58972/B/zzHuntB_clientFrames.test.ts (needs zzHuntB_harness.ts beside it), run from packages/moe-daemon/src/__hunt__/ of a `git archive 942717bc` snapshot. `npx vitest run src/__hunt__/zzHuntB_clientFrames.test.ts` → 3 passed, recording:
  HUNT DAEMON REPLY: {"type":"ERROR","message":"[NOT_ALLOWED] archive epic not allowed: Epic \"epic-1\" has 1 in-flight task(s) (task-working:WORKING). Move them to BACKLOG first via moe.set_task_status (release_task keeps a WORKING task in the WORKING column, so releasing does not make it archivable).","operation":"UPDATE_EPIC","code":-32003,"codeName":"NOT_ALLOWED","context":{"epicId":"epic-1"}}
- After the refusal the test asserts title 'Original title', description 'Original description' and status ACTIVE, so the typed edits were dropped. The control test (same frame, status left ACTIVE) lands the rename.
- The architect's re-run is in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-d5d58972/me/clientFrames.rerun.txt.

FIX DIRECTION (plugin only; the daemon's all-or-nothing archive stays as 625c7cfe designed it)
1. Decide locally, from the cached snapshot, before sending. Choosing Archived for an epic with a PLANNING, AWAITING_APPROVAL or WORKING task sends nothing ARCHIVED. It shows a message listing those tasks by TITLE and saying they must leave those columns first.
2. Confirm the cascade: "Archive epic X and its N task(s)?", where N is the not-yet-ARCHIVED tasks. Cancel sends nothing.
3. Split the save. Send the field edits with the epic's CURRENT status first (updateEpicDetails), then the status change on its own through the existing MoeCommandSender.updateEpicStatus (:93-103) or an equivalent status-only frame. A stale-cache refusal can then never drop the typed edits; the existing balloon still reports it, which is acceptable.
Put the decision in a small pure helper (e.g. toolwindow/EpicArchive.kt) that takes the epic, its tasks and the chosen status, and returns the blockers, the cascade count and the frames to send. That makes it unit-testable without a dialog. New user-visible text goes in MoeBundle.properties, ASCII.

FILES (planner to confirm)
- moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/EpicDetailDialog.kt
- moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/EpicArchive.kt (new pure helper)
- moe-jetbrains/src/main/resources/messages/MoeBundle.properties
- moe-jetbrains/src/test/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/EpicArchiveTest.kt (new)

OUT OF SCOPE: any daemon change (updateEpic.ts and archiveEpic.ts stay as they are); moe-vscode/** (the VS Code twin, EpicDetailPanel.ts:291 and :97-115, is held back until this lands); docs/MCP_SERVER.md, because no MCP contract changes. Docs: docs/PLUGIN_SPEC.md:21 and docs/DEVELOPMENT.md:305 only name the dialog, so if a plugin doc describes the epic status combo, sync that line in this row.

VERIFICATION: under the jetbrains-gradle lease, `cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test --tests 'com.moe.toolwindow.EpicArchiveTest'`, then the plain `./gradlew test` (a CI merge gate).
definitionOfDone: EpicArchiveTest proves the guard. An epic whose cached tasks include a PLANNING, AWAITING_APPROVAL or WORKING row yields no ARCHIVED frame. The helper returns those tasks' TITLES (not ids) for the local message. With none in flight, it reports the cascade count of not-yet-ARCHIVED tasks.

EpicArchiveTest proves the split. Edited fields plus Archived produce a field-edit frame that keeps the epic's current status, BEFORE a separate status-only ARCHIVED frame. Edited fields with an unchanged non-ARCHIVED status still produce exactly one frame, as today.

EpicDetailDialog only sends ARCHIVED after a confirmation that states the task count, and Cancel sends nothing; the dialog calls the helper rather than building frames itself. Under the jetbrains-gradle lease, `./gradlew test --tests 'com.moe.toolwindow.EpicArchiveTest'` and the full `./gradlew test` both exit 0.
